dedupe_keys.name: plateau 3d city model quality management and production system wordpress plugin

description: This is a WordPress plugin developed in Japan's Project PLATEAU and used as a web portal to support quality management of 3D city models. It covers thematic attribute accuracy checks, data input and output and publishing of the models as open data, for CityGML 2.0 extended by the i-UR 2.0 urban revitalisation specification of the Cabinet Office. It runs on WordPress 5.7 with MySQL 5.7 and PHP 7.4 and can use citygml-to-3dtiles to convert models to 3D Tiles and CesiumJS for maps; user guides cover login, datasets, quality management and visual inspection. Coverage: PLATEAU 3D city models of Japan. Access: free on GitHub; the documentation is in Japanese. Licence: GPL. Caveats: last commit April 2023 and pinned to old software versions. Simulation uses are checking attribute quality of building models before they feed flood, evacuation or energy simulations. Related records: the PLATEAU 3D city models, the OGC CityGML standard and Cesium.
name: PLATEAU 3D city model quality management and production system (WordPress plugin)
provider: Project PLATEAU, Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (Japan)
